## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete bug or improvement and any compatibility change.

## Validation

List the checks executed and their results. Distinguish new results from historical evidence.

- [ ] Relevant regression coverage is included, with affected builds identified.
- [ ] Required CI passes; inherited limitations and unverified cases are disclosed.
- [ ] Code/data/fixture origins and licenses are documented; notices are preserved.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic and contain no secrets or private data.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details have been reported privately under SECURITY.md.

For runtime, generated-data or release changes, explain the build/provenance impact. Do not mark checks as completed unless performed.
